tabs.dashboardDesc: Today's form + stats at a glance

timerTab.focusToggleOnTitle: Hide the live card, recent solves and sub-cards. Scramble and timer display take the whole screen. Stays active after reload.
timerTab.focusToggleOffTitle: Back to the full view with live card, recent solves and sub-cards.

smartCube.infoBody: Connects a GAN smart cube (e.g. GAN i4, GAN 12/14 ui, MoYu AI 2023) via the Web Bluetooth API. The current MVP wave only proves the connection works and detects moves. Automatic solve tracking (timer starts/stops with the cube) comes in a follow-up wave. Browser constraint: Chrome / Edge / Brave / Opera (Desktop + Android). Safari and Firefox lack Web Bluetooth.
smartCube.unsupportedBody: Your browser doesn't support Web Bluetooth. Recommended: Chrome / Edge / Brave (Desktop + Android). Safari (iOS/macOS) and Firefox don't support Web Bluetooth.
smartCube.mvpNote: MVP wave: pairing + move indicator only. Auto-time insertion is next.
smartCube.pairingHint: Confirm the browser pairing dialog. The cube must be on (turn one face briefly) and within range.

trustBlock.headerTitle: What we do with your data
trustBlock.headerSubtitle: Short version — full details in the privacy policy
trustBlock.dataLocationBullet1: Hosted at Hetzner in Falkenstein, Germany (GDPR).
trustBlock.dataLocationBullet3: Daily automatic backups, no export to third-country regions.
trustBlock.noTrackingBullet1: No Google Analytics, no Mixpanel, no advertising cookie.
trustBlock.noTrackingBullet2: Exactly one cookie: the login token (HttpOnly + Secure, for auth only).
trustBlock.noTrackingBullet3: Open source on GitHub — you can verify this yourself.
trustBlock.identityBullet1: Display name is free — pseudonyms are fine, we don't check real names.
trustBlock.identityBullet2: We only need your e-mail for login + password reset.
trustBlock.identityBullet3: WCA ID is optional. Stats come live from the WCA API — we store only the ID, not the competition data.
trustBlock.visibilityTitle: Other users only see what you share
trustBlock.visibilityBullet1: Anonymous visitors see nothing about you.
trustBlock.visibilityBullet2: Other users see nothing either — until you're friends.
trustBlock.visibilityBullet3: Friends see your display name + public PRs + hardware. Your e-mail only after both sides accept the friendship.
trustBlock.adminTitle: What admins see — and what they don't
trustBlock.adminBullet1: Visible: e-mail + display name + rough stats (for support + spam detection).
trustBlock.adminBullet2: On support requests: your solves, with an audit log (who looked at what, when).
trustBlock.adminBullet3: Aggregates like "57 active users this week" — no personal analytics behind them.
trustBlock.adminNotSeenNote: Plaintext passwords (bcrypt hash only, irreversible) · Other users' backups (backup scope = your account only) · Live WCA profile data (comes from api.worldcubeassociation.org, not from our DB) · Third-party IDs (we have none).

activity.infoBodyToday: Shows solve count + cube distribution for today (since 0:00 your local time). Active cubes as top 3, the rest aggregated. Updates live after every new solve.
activity.infoBodyWeek: Shows solve count + cube distribution for the last 7 days. Active cubes as top 3, the rest aggregated. Updates live after every new solve.

news.title: Speedcubing news
news.infoBody1: Curated news from the cubing scene: WCA announcements (official messages from the World Cube Association) + r/Cubers (Reddit community).
news.infoBody2: Refreshed once an hour in the background. Click a title to open the original.
news.emptyText: No news available right now. This happens on the first call — reload the page in a minute and they should be there.

wca.title: WCA competitions
wca.infoBody1: List of the next official WCA competitions near you, sorted by date. Distance is calculated from the postal code in your profile (Settings → Account, straight-line).
wca.infoBody2: Data comes directly from the official World Cube Association API. Click a competition name to open the WCA detail page with registration status, events, venue.
wca.loading: Loading competitions from the WCA API …
wca.profileIncompleteBody: For "competitions near you" to work, set postal code and country under Settings → Preferences → Account → Profile. Distance is calculated as a straight-line — your exact address stays private.
wca.noCompetitions: No WCA competitions within {{km}} km in the next {{months}} months.

achievementsMini.title: Achievements
achievementsMini.infoBody: 30+ personal-trainer goals you unlock on the side (e.g. "first sub-20 solve", "100 solves in a day", "PB streak"). Click the card to open the Trainer tab with all achievements + progress.
achievementsMini.emptyText: No achievements unlocked yet. Keep training!

challengesMini.title: Daily challenges
challengesMini.infoBody: Three small daily tasks, new each day (midnight UTC). Click the card to open the Trainer tab with the full list + progress. Completed challenges count toward long-term achievements.

onboarding.intro: Your database is still empty. Three ways in:
onboarding.importTip: Tip: csTimer import detects duplicates — you can load the same file multiple times without getting duplicate entries.

authPages.tokenMissingBody: The link doesn't contain a token. Try again via
authPages.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
authPages.setNewHint: Choose your new password (at least 8 characters).
authPages.verifyFailFallback: Verification link is invalid or expired.
authPages.verifyFailHint: Try again: sign in and click "Resend verification email" in your settings.

auth.forgotInfo: If the email address is registered, a reset link is on its way. Please check your spam folder too.

footer.moreOptionsHint: More options in the top-right user menu

timerControls.modeInfoTextBody: You type the time after solving and hit Enter. Classic, fine if you use a separate stopwatch.
timerControls.modeInfoWcaBody: Competition standard. Press Space to start inspection (15s), press + hold + release to start the solve. Press Space to stop. Penalty automatic (+2 from 15s, DNF from 17s).
timerControls.modeInfoPragmaticBody: Training-friendly. Single tap during inspection starts the solve, double-tap restarts inspection. Auto-DNF at countdown 0. A bit more relaxed than WCA.
timerControls.tipTouch: on phone, text input through the soft keyboard is a bit tedious — spacebar tap is usually faster.
timerControls.tipDesktop: Try the spacebar timer — much smoother training, including inspection countdown. Just click one of the spacebar modes above.

scramble.title: Scramble
scramble.infoBody1: Random twist sequence using WCA notation. Letters = face (R, L, U, D, F, B), prime ("L'") = counter-clockwise, digit 2 = double turn. Apply the scramble to a solved cube — then all solves are comparable under the same conditions. "Skip" generates a new one.
scramble.infoBody2: Default is the scramble that matches your selected cube type. Toggle "WCA" ↔ "Unofficial" + dropdown to choose another type. Switching the cube type resets the override automatically.
scramble.customButtonTitle: Type your own scramble (e.g. from another app / competition)
scramble.skipTitle: Skip this scramble, generate a new one
scramble.fromSessionOverride: From session override: "{{label}}" — pick a toggle to change
scramble.editPlaceholder: e.g. R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R' U' R U R' F'
scramble.editNoValidation: Input is not validated — make sure the notation matches the cube type yourself.
scramble.notAvailable: Scramble not available for this type.
scramble.randomMoveWarning: Note: random-move sequence with correct notation, not a random-state solver. Fine for training, not 100% comparable to competition. Random-state is being added step by step.

solveList.title: Solves
solveList.emptyNoFilter: No solves yet. Enter one above or import your csTimer data.
solveList.infoBody: All your solves in chronological order (newest first). Click a column header #/Time/AO5/AO12 to sort. Click on a time or note to edit inline. The ℹ button per row shows scramble + hardware + session details.
solveList.limitTitle: Maximum number of solves to show
solveList.tipFooter: Tip: click a column header (#, Time, AO5, AO12) to sort · click a time to edit · ℹ for details (scramble, note, hardware, session). Enter saves, Esc cancels.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.infoEmpty: Lists cubes you haven't touched for more than {{days}} days. Sorted: most-forgotten first. Considers all active hardware cubes (Settings → Hardware).
reminders.infoActive: Cubes you haven't touched for more than {{days}} days. Click a row to set your timer cube filter — quick jump into training.
reminders.allFresh: All cubes trained within the last {{days}} days. ✅

recentPbs.title: 🏆 Recent records
recentPbs.emptyText: No personal bests yet — as soon as you save solves, your latest single / ao5 / ao12 PBs will appear here along with the improvement over the previous PB.
recentPbs.infoBody: Your latest personal bests across all cubes. Gold ★ = single PB, cyan ● = ao5 PB, emerald ● = ao12 PB. The Δ value shows how much you beat the previous PB. Click a row to open the PB history in the Analysis tab.
recentPbs.clickHint: Click to open the PB history in the Analysis tab
recentPbs.deltaTitle: Improvement over the previous PB of the same metric

stats.title: Statistics
stats.noSolves: No solves match the current filter yet.
stats.infoText: Best single + best/current AO5/AO12/AO100 for the current selection (cube + session). WCA-compliant: +2 counts as time+2s, DNF is trimmed from averages. "Best AO5" = best AO5 ever achieved across all solves; "current AO5" = the last 5.

charts.trendsEmpty: No data in the current filter.
charts.trendsInfoBody: Your solve times over time. Dots = individual solves (singles), lines = rolling averages (AO5/AO12). Y-axis: time (smaller = better). Helps spot plateaus + breakthroughs. Y-range can be set manually for detail focus.
charts.trendsLimitTitle: Number of latest solves in chart
charts.pbProgInfoBody: Each point = a new personal best (PB) at the moment it was set. The staircase only goes down — so you see your improvement over time. Switchable: Single / ao5 / ao12.
charts.pbProgEmpty: No {{metric}} PBs in the current filter yet.
charts.histEmpty: No valid solves in the current filter.
charts.histInfoBody: How often a given time occurred — grouped into time bins. A nice bell shape = consistent performance. Long tails to the right = outliers (e.g. mistake solves). DNFs are filtered out (axis would otherwise be infinite).
charts.actInfoBody: How many solves you did per day / week / month. Granularity via the selector on the right. Helps see training consistency — long breaks vs streaks.
charts.actFooter: Empty days/weeks/months show as 0. Filters (cube, session) apply here too.
charts.hwInfoBody: Compares your stats per cube (hardware entry) for the selected cube type. Helps see whether a particular speedcube is really faster or just feels that way. Click a column header to sort.
charts.hwNoCubeFilter: Set a cube filter above to see with which cube you're faster.
charts.hwEmpty: No data for this cube yet.
charts.hwFooter: ★ = cube with the best single PB. Click a column header to sort by that column (click again = reverse direction). "No hardware" includes csTimer imports and solves without explicit hardware assignment.

multiCompare.title: Comparison
multiCompare.infoBody: Side-by-side table of your stats — either by cube type (3x3 vs 4x4 vs 5x5 …) or by session (e.g. "OH" vs "Cold Solves"). Helps you see where you make progress and where you train less.
multiCompare.emptyCube: Not enough data yet (min. 5 solves per cube).
multiCompare.emptySession: No sessions with enough solves yet (min. 5).
multiCompare.emptySessionCubes: No cube data in this session.
multiCompare.subtitle: ao5 {{ao5}} · mean {{mean}} · PB {{pb}}
multiCompare.footerHint: Click a row → drill-down. ▼ = currently better than the mean of the last 100 solves, ▲ = worse.

dangerZone.title: ⚠ Danger zone
dangerZone.introSuffix: . Each action requires a second confirmation within 5 seconds.
dangerZone.backupError: Backup could not be created. Please try again BEFORE performing a destructive action.
dangerZone.doneSolves: ✓ All solves have been deleted. Sessions, hardware and achievements are preserved.
dangerZone.doneTracking: ✓ Tracking data has been reset — account and hardware inventory remain (your setup).
dangerZone.solvesDesc: All your solves will be deleted. Sessions, hardware inventory, achievements and your account remain untouched.
dangerZone.solvesUseCase: Use case: test data away, start fresh with your own hardware setup.
dangerZone.trackingDesc: Solves + sessions + achievements + daily-challenges history will be deleted. Account and hardware inventory remain — your setup.
dangerZone.trackingUseCase: Use case: complete restart, but keep your cube collection.
dangerZone.accountDesc: GDPR: all your data including login will be irrevocably deleted. You will be logged out automatically afterwards.
dangerZone.accountUseCase: Use case: complete withdrawal from cubetracker.
dangerZone.actionTitleOtherArmed: Another action is currently armed — cancel that first
dangerZone.actionTitleIdle: First click arms, second click (within 5s) executes

lastSolvesPreview.liveInfoBody: Shows your latest solve + the four current averages: Mo3 (arithmetic mean of the last 3), AO5/AO12/AO100 (WCA-compliant trimmed mean of the last 5/12/100). "Form vs" compares your current level with the mean of a selectable window (last 100/500/all). Green = better than average, red = worse.
lastSolvesPreview.tableInfoBody: The most recently entered solves of this cube type. Count is selectable (10/20/50/100/200/500/All). Click a column header to sort (solve number, time, AO5, AO12). DNFs and empty averages land at the end when sorting. Over 100 rows scroll inside the card instead of stretching the page.
lastSolvesPreview.pbOldTitle: Was a PB at some point
lastSolvesPreview.noSolves: No solves for {{cube}} yet. Type a time on the right.
lastSolvesPreview.sortHint: Click a column header to sort.

sessionList.title: Sessions
sessionList.infoBody: Sessions structure your training (e.g. "OH", "PLL drill", "cold solves"). Solves are assigned to a session, stats can be filtered per session. The "merge" function combines sessions, "migrate" moves solves before deletion.
sessionList.empty: No sessions yet. They appear automatically on csTimer import or on first solve via "+ New session" in the TIMER.
sessionList.mergeButtonTitle: Merge into another session — solves move over, notes are appended
sessionList.footer: Click on name or note to edit. Merging moves all solves into another session, deleting can optionally move solves instead of leaving them orphaned.
sessionList.deleteModalQuestion: What should happen with the solves of this session?
sessionList.deleteOptionOrphanDesc: session_id becomes NULL — solves stay in the list, without session assignment.
sessionList.mergeModalDescPrefix: All solves of this session move to the target session. Notes are appended in the target session. This session is then deleted. This action is

hardwareList.title: Hardware inventory
hardwareList.infoBody: Your cube collection. Each new user automatically gets 30 standard cubes (all inactive) — tick off the ones you really own + bulk-activate them. Active cubes appear in the timer hardware selector + in the hardware comparison. Solves keep their hardware assignment even after deletion.
hardwareList.emptyState: Inventory is empty. Add a new cube above, or log out + back in to re-seed the default list.
hardwareList.bulkDeleteConfirm:
Really delete {{count}} marked hardware entries?
Affected solves will lose their hardware assignment but stay.
hardwareList.footer: Auto-seed: each new user gets 30 standard cubes with is_active=false. You tick off what you really own (checkbox + ▶ activate). "Rename" button or click on the name to edit — Enter saves, Esc cancels. Deleting only removes the hardware entry, old solves remain.
hardwareList.renameButtonTitle: Rename — alternative way to clicking on the name
hardwareList.deleteButtonTitle: Delete — solves stay, hardware_id becomes NULL
hardwareList.deleteConfirm:
Really delete hardware "{{name}}"?

Affected solves stay but lose their hardware assignment.

outlierCard.title: Suspicious times
outlierCard.infoBody: Lists solves that deviate significantly from your cube type's median (e.g. 3x more than the median). Typical causes: mistyped time, csTimer import with wrong scaling, misclicks. You can delete them directly or set DNF/+2. Per-session or per-cube median selectable.
outlierCard.emptyAll: No suspicious times in the data. ✅
outlierCard.emptySession: No suspicious times in the selected session. ✅
outlierCard.introAll: Solves that deviate significantly from this cube's typical pace (probably timer errors or forgotten solves).
outlierCard.introSession: Solves that deviate significantly from this cube's typical pace (probably timer errors or forgotten solves). Only the active session.
outlierCard.dnfButtonTitle: Mark as DNF — stays in data but is excluded from stats

settingsPanel.spacebarInfoBody: Deeper settings for the spacebar timer. Mode (WCA vs pragmatic) can also be picked directly in the timer tab. Inspection duration, hold time, sound signals, phase splits are configurable here.
settingsPanel.spacebarEnableHint: WCA standard flow: hold space → release starts, press space stops. Classic text input remains available in parallel.
settingsPanel.spacebarHoldTimeHint: How long space must be held until it turns green. WCA recommendation 550ms.
settingsPanel.inspectionEnableHint: A countdown runs before the solve.
settingsPanel.inspectionModeWcaDesc: Single space → solve in "hold" (release starts); +2 from 15s, DNF from 17s.
settingsPanel.inspectionModePragmaticDesc: Single space (250ms latency) starts solve directly; double tap = reset; auto-DNF at 0.
settingsPanel.inspectionModeNote: Note: your cube doesn't have to lie on the keyboard at the same time — pausing is OK.
settingsPanel.inspectionSoundHint: Audio signal at 8s + urgent double signal at 12s. Mode selectable below.
settingsPanel.inspectionAudioModeNote: Voice modes use browser TTS — works offline + without assets, voice depends on browser/OS.
settingsPanel.splitsEnableHint: Multiple spacebar presses per solve, each press registers a split. Classic CFOP breakdown: Cross / F2L / OLL / PLL.
settingsPanel.timerFontDesc: Affects the input field in /timer and the scramble display.
settingsPanel.scrambleImageEnableHint: Cube preview (cross layout) directly below the notation. Helps verify whether you executed the scramble correctly. Currently 3x3 only — other cube types show no image. Also toggleable directly in the /timer tab (button "Image on/off" next to "Custom" / "Skip").
settingsPanel.drillFontDesc: Applies to ALL drill windows in the trainer (currently: PLL/OLL drill). Separately adjustable from the timer size.

accountSettings.infoBody: Profile data + security. Change display name, change password (logs you out automatically), change email address (with re-verification of the new address), discoverable toggle for the friends search, delete your account completely (GDPR).
accountSettings.geoNoteBody: Postal code and country are required together for
accountSettings.geoNoteBodyTail: (dashboard). Otherwise the location cannot be geocoded + the list stays empty.
accountSettings.geoNotePrivacy: The postal code is used exclusively for distance calculation, not shared further. Your exact address stays private.
accountSettings.okVerifyResent: Verification email resent. Check your inbox.
accountSettings.discoverabilityDescPrefix: When active, other users can find you by
accountSettings.discoverabilityDescSuffix: you are always findable (by whoever knows the address). Default: off.
accountSettings.discoverabilityToggleLabel: Other users can find me by display name
accountSettings.discoverabilityNoNameWarn: ⚠ Set a display name first — otherwise there's nothing to find.
accountSettings.okDiscoverable: You are now discoverable to other users.
accountSettings.wcaIdHeading: WCA ID (link your official WCA profile)
accountSettings.wcaIdDescPrefix: If you have an official World Cube Association ID (assigned after your first competition), enter it here — the app will then show your official WCA PRs + recent competitions next to your Cubetracker stats. You can find it at
accountSettings.wcaIdDescSuffix: (format: 4 digits year + 4 capital letters + 2 digits, e.g. 2024SMIT01). Fully optional — leaving it empty turns the card off.
accountSettings.wcaIdInvalid: Invalid format — expected e.g. "2024SMIT01" (4 digits + 4 letters + 2 digits).
accountSettings.okWcaIdSaved: WCA ID saved. The WCA card on the dashboard will update in a moment.
accountSettings.okWcaIdCleared: WCA ID removed. The WCA card on the dashboard is now hidden.
accountSettings.okPasswordChanged: Password changed. You will be logged out automatically — please log in again with the new password.
accountSettings.emailDescription: The old email address stays active until the new one is confirmed.
accountSettings.emailSubmit: Send verify email to new address
accountSettings.okEmailVerifySent: Verification email on its way to {{email}}. Click the link in the email to activate the new address.
accountSettings.dangerDescription: GDPR: You can delete your account + all data irrevocably at any time. Recommended beforehand: download a full backup under "Data".
accountSettings.dangerConfirm:
REALLY delete your account?

ALL your data (solves, sessions, hardware, achievements, snapshots) will be removed irrevocably.

Proceed?

features.tagline: Speedcubing tracking, reimagined. Measure solves, analyse your form, compare with friends.
features.heroHighlight1: WCA-compliant timer with spacebar + touch mode
features.heroHighlight2: csTimer import — full data carried over
features.heroHighlight3: WCA tournaments near you + speedcubing news on the dashboard
features.solvingBullet1: WCA-compliant timer with spacebar mode + inspection (15s countdown, +2/DNF penalty automatic)
features.solvingBullet2: Three timer modes selectable directly in the timer tab: text input / spacebar WCA / spacebar pragmatic
features.solvingBullet3: Touch timer for phones: tap + hold replaces the space key
features.solvingBullet4: Scramble generator for all WCA cubes (2x2 to 7x7, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1, Megaminx, Clock) PLUS unofficial ones (Ivy, Gear, Redi, Master Pyraminx, Master Skewb, FTO) — picker right in the scramble card
features.solvingBullet5: 2D cube net preview directly below the 3x3 scramble: at a glance you see what the cube must look like after applying — perfect for verifying you executed the scramble correctly (toggleable in settings)
features.solvingBullet6: Training sets: plan 5/12/25/50/100 solves, end-of-set statistics + coaching feedback
features.solvingBullet7: Auto-preselect: the most-used hardware for the current cube is suggested
features.solvingBullet8: Sessions structure training (e.g. OH, PLL drills, cold solves)
features.analysisBullet1: Best Times: Single, Mo3, AO5, AO12, AO100 — all WCA-compliant (+2 + DNF trim)
features.analysisBullet2: Best-Avg timestamps: for each Best-AO you see the date it was achieved
features.analysisBullet3: Current form display: live AO5/AO12 vs average of last 100/500/all
features.analysisBullet4: Sortable solve list with solve numbers, Mo3/AO5/AO12/AO100 as columns, hardware assignment
features.analysisBullet5: Detail modal per solve: full scramble + note + context via ℹ button
features.analysisBullet6: Charts: trends over time, distribution histogram, daily activity
features.analysisBullet7: PB history: all personal best times remain marked as PB (even old/superseded ones), plus a history chart of single/AO5/AO12 records over time
features.analysisBullet8: Average-PB markers in the solve list: small coloured dot on each ao5/ao12 value that was a Best-Avg at the time it was set (cyan for ao5, emerald for ao12, gold ★ for single PB)
features.analysisBullet9: Hardware performance comparison: which cube is faster for which type
features.trainerBullet1: Achievements: 30+ unlocks you collect along the way
features.trainerBullet2: Daily Challenges: a new small task every day
features.trainerBullet3: Algs trainer for PLL + OLL with self-test mode — OLL with all 57 visualisations (PLL images to follow)
features.communityBullet1: Friends system: find users by display name or email, send/accept requests
features.communityBullet2: Privacy opt-in: only those with "Discoverable" enabled can be found by display name
features.communityBullet3: Leaderboard: compare your Best Single / AO5 / AO12 with your friends
features.hardwareBullet1: Standard list of 30 popular cubes is created automatically (default inactive)
features.hardwareBullet2: You tick off the cubes you really own + get statistics per hardware
features.hardwareBullet3: Bulk actions per cube type (activate / deactivate / delete)
features.hardwareBullet4: Add your own cubes + rename freely
features.worldBullet1: WCA tournaments near you: list of upcoming official competitions with distance calculation (straight line) based on your postal code + country from your profile
features.worldBullet2: DACH bonus: users in DE/AT/CH automatically also see tournaments from direct neighbouring countries (DE users e.g. AT, CH, NL, BE, LU, FR, DK, PL, CZ)
features.worldBullet3: Speedcubing news from three curated sources: WCA Announcements (official notices), SpeedCubing.org (World Records + coverage), r/Cubers (community)
features.worldBullet4: Auto-refresh: on every login we check in the background whether new news is available — by your first dashboard visit they're there, no wait
features.worldBullet5: Data sources are the official WCA API + OpenStreetMap geocoding (no trackers, no third-party cookies)
features.worldBullet6: Set your WCA ID → the app fetches your official WCA PRs + recent competitions straight from the WCA API and shows them next to your Cubetracker stats on the dashboard
features.dataBullet1: Admin → My Data: one-click full backup of your solves, sessions, hardware and achievements as open JSON — you keep full data sovereignty, export or import any time
features.dataBullet2: Danger zone under My Data: three graduated delete actions (reset solves / reset tracking data / delete account entirely) — each with a 2-click confirmation and a prominent backup hint
features.dataBullet3: csTimer import: your existing data is carried over completely (sessions + solves + scrambles + notes)
features.dataBullet4: csTimer-compatible export: switchable data sovereignty any time
features.dataBullet5: Full backup as JSON incl. achievements + daily challenges history
features.dataBullet6: Automatic snapshots before larger changes (restore/bulk import)
features.accountBullet1: Privacy policy + imprint publicly accessible (footer links, even without login) — no cookie banner needed, no tracking, no third-party analytics
features.accountBullet2: Email verification + password reset via mail
features.accountBullet3: Display name + email-change flow with re-verification
features.accountBullet4: Postal code + country in profile (optional) — feeds the WCA tournament search on the dashboard. Used exclusively for distance calculation, never shared
features.accountBullet5: Account deletion (GDPR compliant, all data gone)
features.accountBullet6: Multi-user isolation: your data is technically separated from others
features.modalSubheading: Multi-user web app for tracking + analysing speedcubing solves.
features.modalFooter: Multi-user web variant, actively under construction. Data lives in a Postgres DB, no tracking, no ad code.

dailyChallenges.title: Daily challenges
dailyChallenges.infoBody: Three small daily tasks. Regenerated at midnight UTC. Difficulties vary (e.g. "do X solves today", "reach AO5 under Y", "no DNF in 10 solves"). Dismiss function for challenges you don't want to tackle today. Refresh button generates new ones (e.g. if you got something impossible).
dailyChallenges.regenerateButtonTitle: Discards today's challenges and regenerates fresh
dailyChallenges.emptyState: No active challenges for today. Click "Regenerate" to create some.
dailyChallenges.footer: Challenges are regenerated daily (based on your stats) and their progress counts monotonically upward — even if a solve is deleted later, completion stays.

challenges.descComeback: Do at least one {{cube}} solve — it hasn't been trained for a while

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.infoBody: 30+ personal trainer goals in categories (volume, speed, consistency, streaks, etc.). Checked automatically after every solve. Locked achievements show hint text — gives you the next training goal without spoiling. "Recheck" runs the full check again (backup after large imports).
achievements.recheckButtonTitle: Recheck manually — e.g. after a data import
achievements.footer: Achievements are monotonic: once unlocked they stay, even if the requirement is no longer met later (e.g. after deleting solves).

algTrainer.title: Algorithm trainer
algTrainer.infoBody: Drill mode for PLL + OLL algorithms. Sub-sets selectable (e.g. "edge permutations only"), scrambles are randomly generated as the inverse of the desired algorithm. Solve the scramble + save the time per algorithm — helps identify weak spots.
algTrainer.emptyState: Click a case on the left to drill it.
algTrainer.footer: Sort: weakest current ao5 first — where you should train first. Cases without data at the end. Each drill solve is automatically tagged with `alg_case` (cube type stays 3x3).

drillCard.label: Drill
drillCard.skipButtonTitle: Generate new scramble for the same case

drillSolves.empty: No drill solves for this case yet.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.infoBody: Compares you + accepted friends for the selected cube type. Columns: Best Single, Best AO5, Best AO12, current AO5, solves (30d), last active. You are always highlighted at the top, friends sorted by Best Single (top 3 with medals). Only accepted friends, no emails in the output.
leaderboard.noFriendsBodySuffix: tab, find someone by display name or email and send a request. Once accepted, they show up here.
leaderboard.footer: Best times are calculated by WCA convention: +2 counts as time+2.0s, DNF counts as "infinite" / trimmed in averages. AO5 = trimmed mean of 5 solves (drop best+worst, average the middle 3).
leaderboard.tableEmpty: Nobody has any {{cube}} solves yet. Be the first!

friends.discoverableHeaderSuffix: as "{{name}}". Other users can find you via display name search.
friends.onboardingBodySuffix: . You can still find others by email lookup + send them friend requests. To let others find YOU by display name you need both:
friends.enableTitleReady: Allow others to find you by display name
friends.searchInfoDisplayNameRest: (prefix match, from 2 characters, only users with "discoverable" enabled);
friends.searchInfoEmailRest: (bypasses the discoverable gate — whoever knows the email knows the user). Search results immediately show the relationship status (e.g. "already friends", "request open").

feedback.title: 💬 Give feedback
feedback.intro: Found a bug? Feature wish? Something doesn't work? There are two ways:
feedback.anonHint: You're not logged in — feedback only via GitHub here. Log in to write directly in the app (replies come back to your account).
feedback.githubIntro: Reports in the GitHub issue tracker end up public + other users see + comment along. Preferred for:
feedback.githubBullet2: Feature wishes where discussion makes sense
feedback.githubBullet3: You already have a GitHub account
feedback.githubTemplates: We have templates for bug reports + feature wishes that walk you step by step through the important questions.
feedback.appIntro: Write directly in the app — your message lands in the admin inbox. As soon as someone has replied, you'll see it under "Manage → My data → My feedback" and get a small notification at next login.

roadmap.title: 🗺 Roadmap
roadmap.feedbackHintPrefix: Got wishes or missing items? Tell us via the footer link
roadmap.internalBadgeTitle: Admin-only — dev/tech-debt item, users don't see this
roadmap.intro: Cubetracker is under active development — no feature freeze. This list shows what's coming next + why. Ordering is based on user value vs. effort vs. strategic differentiation from csTimer.
roadmap.emptyState: No roadmap items at the moment. Check back later!

phases.p1Summary: Quick wins that bring Cubetracker up to csTimer level — visible value, low effort per item.
phases.p2Summary: Done: moved to our own Hetzner Cloud server with Coolify — own domain, HTTPS, daily backups, all data migrated. The app now runs on our own infrastructure.
phases.p3Summary: Cubetracker's strategic bet: the social cubing app. csTimer has NONE of this — this phase makes us unique.
phases.p4Summary: Catch up with csTimer on power-user features. Highest effort, but indispensable if Cubetracker is to be taken seriously.
phases.p5Summary: Scaling — opening up the market + remaining custom scrambles.
phases.p6Summary: Features for deep-user requests — built when someone specifically asks. Ordering depends on demand.

backupPanel.title: Backup & restore
backupPanel.infoBody: Full export of your data (solves, sessions, hardware, achievements) as a JSON file. Restore from your own backup using merge mode (nothing is overwritten) or replace mode (everything is rewritten, with a confirm string). Snapshots = restore points, max 2 per user — created automatically before larger operations (restore, bulk import).
backupPanel.subtitle: Full export of your data (JSON), restore from file, snapshots as restore points (max 2 per user).
backupPanel.section1Desc: Readable JSON export of all your data — solves, sessions, hardware, achievements, challenges. Recommended before larger changes + as backup against the 90-day Postgres limit.
backupPanel.section2DescMergeRest: is safe and the default — existing data stays, new entries are added with dedup.
backupPanel.section2DescReplaceRest: is destructive — requires an extra confirmation + creates a snapshot beforehand automatically.
backupPanel.replaceConfirmError: Type "{{magic}}" exactly into the confirm field to confirm the destructive restore.
backupPanel.section3Subtitle: Max {{count}} per user — oldest is discarded when creating a new one.
backupPanel.snapshotsEmpty: No snapshots. Create one before making big data changes.
backupPanel.snapshotRestoreConfirm:
Restore snapshot #{{id}}?

ALL current data will be replaced by the state from {{date}}.

Proceed?

importPanel.title: csTimer import
importPanel.subtitle: (migration from csTimer)
importPanel.infoBody: Upload your csTimer export file (.txt or .json) and cubetracker takes over your complete inventory: sessions, solves, scrambles, notes, +2/DNF penalties, timestamps. Re-import detects duplicates (timestamp + time_ms) automatically — nothing is added twice. Dry-run option shows what would happen first.
importPanel.description: Upload a csTimer export file (.txt or .json). Re-import detects duplicates automatically — nothing is added twice.
importPanel.warning: ⚠ Do not upload the Cubetracker backup JSON here — that belongs under "Backup & restore" above. csTimer export files are typically named cstimer_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.txt.
importPanel.busy: Import running … (can take 10-30 seconds for large files)

csTimerExport.title: csTimer export
csTimerExport.infoBody: Exports your solves + sessions in csTimer JSON format. You can import the file into csTimer (there: Settings → Backup → Import) — e.g. to continue using cubetracker data on a csTimer mobile app, or as an additional backup variant. Data sovereignty stays with you.
csTimerExport.description: Exports your solves + sessions in csTimer JSON format. You can import the file into csTimer (Settings → Backup → Import) and continue using cubetracker data there.
csTimerExport.notInExportRest: : hardware assignment (csTimer doesn't know the concept) and cubetracker achievements/challenges. For a full backup please use the backup panel above. Solves without a session assignment land in a pseudo-session "No session".

verwaltung.formatHintBackup: Cubetracker backup (filename e.g. cubetracker_…_….json): upload under "Backup & restore".
verwaltung.formatHintCstimer: csTimer export (filename e.g. cstimer_20260513_….txt or .json): upload under "csTimer import".

trainingSet.infoBody: Set yourself a fixed number of solves as a target (e.g. 12 or 50). As you solve, the set counts down and shows live stats. At the end you get a summary: best, worst, AO5, AO12, AO100, plus DNF/+2 stats. Useful for focused training with a clear stopping point.
